verdict.rationale: The current Terms state that users who don't want their Materials used to train AI models can opt out at app.instinct.com/settings, and that Vault Materials are never used for training. Community screenshots of the original ToS show a 'perpetual and irrevocable' license that included model training, but that concerns an earlier version and does not contradict the current opt-out. missing for 10: training is on by default (opt-out rather than opt-in), no hands-on or independent confirmation that the opt-out setting works, no detail on its scope or whether it applies to data already collected.
